correction: NOT_DONE is right, but some of the evidence is stale and the sketch is incomplete. (a) The claim that activateHostedNode 'builds a new connection and client on every recovery' has been wrong since a38ecac4b (merged through cf1253f1e, perf2/p2-hosted-connect). In-session relay drops on web and mobile now adopt the transport's replacement channel and keep the same connection and WsRpcClient (transport.ts:428-431 -> state.ts:2624 connectionRecovered; mobile primaryConnection.ts:193-197). On that path the per-connection hasShellBaseline already survives. The only blocker there is the hosted gate (service.ts:857/1296, plus the missing mobile wiring), and the adopted channel still pulls one full snapshot per drop. Only foreground suspend/resume, retrySelectedNode and node switches still rebuild the connection. (b) Hoisting hasShellBaseline is not enough for the cross-connection case. supervision.ts:818-830 remove(), which disconnectPrimary calls, runs projectionTracker.clearEnvironment, so readShellProjectionSequence returns null after any suspend or reactivation. It also unsubscribes the thread subscriptions, whose appliedSequence lives in the attach closure. (c) The auditor left out that thread windows are excluded too: supervision.ts:561-565 sets resumable = !isHostedMode && source !== 'hub-hosted', and supervision.test.ts:424-441 locks that in. (d) The auditor's step 3 (mark the session ready on the resumed reply) is not equivalent to 'accept a current shell'. The node sends the `resumed` head item before a replay backlog of up to ORCHESTRATION_REPLAY_PAGE_MAX_LIMIT = 1000 events (orchestrationStreams.ts:813-818, 865-876; constants.ts:3), and nothing marks the end of that replay. (e) Node revisit cannot resume as-is. deactivateCurrentHostedNode -> clearWebHostedNodeScopedState demotes the environment to a cached snapshot and resets the E2EE session (apps/web/src/hostedHub/environment.ts:45,53), so no live baseline is left to resume onto.
decisionReason: Hosted resume relaxes the AGENTS.md:63-65 hosted lifecycle rule (accept a current shell snapshot before mutation capability) and docs/hosted-hub-client.md:381 ('Nothing is resumed'). It changes when hosted mutation authority is published, so it needs product/security sign-off. Doing it safely most likely also needs a node protocol addition (a caught-up/current marker after the resume replay, gated by a capability). That marker is a node/contracts change, not a Hub protocol change. The relay and E2EE semantics do not change. To reach hosted users the change ships through a Hub vendored-Ryco pin bump and deploy.
summary: Hosted shell resume is still not implemented. Web hosted connections are excluded at service.ts:857 and :1296, and the mobile hosted primary (primaryConnection.ts:243) does not wire readShellResumeSequence. Hosted thread windows are excluded at supervision.ts:562. Since the report, a38ecac4b made in-session relay drops keep the connection instead of rebuilding the client, which halved the per-drop cost from two snapshots to one. Each drop still downloads, decrypts and hydrates the full shell plus retained thread windows. Foreground resume (every iOS background/foreground and web freeze/pagehide/offline), retrySelectedNode and node switches still rebuild the connection, and supervisor remove() wipes the projection sequence. No Hub-side or renamed implementation exists.

evidence.note: `resumeShell = options.resumeShell === true && hostedGeneration === null` still excludes hosted. The doc comment at 825-831 states the policy. onShellResumed (863-866) only completes the query refresh and never calls markHostedSessionReady (snapshot path does so at 895-906).
The primary passes `{ resumeShell: hostedGeneration === null }`. Only the saved direct path at 1593 passes resumeShell: true.

The mobile hosted primary createEnvironmentConnection has no readShellResumeSequence/onShellResumed. Readiness comes only from syncShellSnapshot onCurrent/onReady (272-286). environmentDriver.ts:508-511 says the hosted primary always takes a fresh snapshot.

Thread detail/window subscriptions use `resumable = !input.isHostedMode() && source !== 'hub-hosted'`, so every hosted reconnect also re-downloads each retained thread window. supervision.test.ts:424-441 asserts this ('always takes a fresh snapshot over the Hub relay / in hosted mode').

hasShellBaseline is per connection. resumeFromSequence is offered only when it is set, and wsRpcClient.ts:83 reads it at every (re)subscription including the first. On an adopted relay channel (same connection) the baseline exists, so the hosted gate is the only blocker there.

Since a38ecac4b, an unintentional relay close followed by a replacement channel coming online calls connectionRecovered instead of retrySelectedNode. The client and connection are kept and subscriptions resubscribe on the same WsRpcClient. state.ts:2624-2640 connectionRecovered does not bump the generation. markSessionReady (2641-2645) refuses readiness while #relayGapGeneration is current.

suspendBrowser bumps the generation and calls suspendHostedNode, which disconnects the primary (environment.ts:57-65). resumeBrowser -> #retrySelectedNode (2477-2523) -> activateHostedNode (environment.ts:67-92) builds a fresh connection. Web triggers on freeze/pagehide/offline (apps/web/src/hostedHub/browserLifecycle.ts). Mobile triggers on every app background (useHostedAppLifecycle.ts).

remove() (used by disconnectPrimary at 907-913) calls projectionTracker.clearEnvironment and unsubscribes thread subscriptions. After any suspend or reactivation, readShellProjectionSequence (1295-1298) returns null, so a cross-connection resume also needs the sequence captured or preserved, not just a hoisted hasShellBaseline.

A node switch (deactivateCurrentHostedNode) resets the E2EE session and demotes the environment to a cached snapshot. The finding's 'node revisit' case therefore has no live projection to resume onto.

The node already honours resumeFromSequence for the shell via canResumeAfter. The `resumed` head item (865-876) is emitted before the bounded replay (up to ORCHESTRATION_REPLAY_PAGE_MAX_LIMIT = 1000, apps/server/src/ws/context/constants.ts:3), and no end-of-replay marker follows.
'Nothing is resumed' is unchanged. AGENTS.md:63-65 still requires accepting a current shell snapshot before mutation capability.
git grep finds no resumeFromSequence/resumeShell logic outside the vendored Ryco. No Hub-side implementation.

remaining: Every hosted reconnect still transfers, decrypts, decodes and hydrates the full OrchestrationShellSnapshot (estimated ~363 KiB for the user's DB) plus every retained thread window. This happens in two cases. (1) In-session relay drops: the connection is kept since a38ecac4b, but the gate at apps/web/src/environments/runtime/service.ts:857 and :1296, the missing wiring at apps/mobile/src/hostedHub/primaryConnection.ts:243, and the thread exclusion at packages/client-runtime/src/connection/supervision.ts:562 force fresh snapshots. (2) Foreground resume (mobile background/foreground every time, web freeze/pagehide/offline), retrySelectedNode and session-sync retries: the connection is rebuilt (packages/client-runtime/src/authorization/environment.ts:57-92), and supervision.ts:818-830 remove() clears the projection sequence and thread subscriptions. Readiness on resume also needs a definition of 'current', because the `resumed` item precedes up to 1000 replayed events (orchestrationStreams.ts:865-876). The policy docs (AGENTS.md:63-65, docs/hosted-hub-client.md:381) need sign-off and updating.
implementationSketch: Phase A, same connection (in-session relay drop, connection already kept since a38ecac4b). (1) Node protocol: in apps/server/src/ws/context/orchestrationStreams.ts makeReplayableShellStream (and makeReplayableThreadStream), when `resumed`, emit a trailing `{kind:'current', sequence}` item after the bounded replay stream ends and before live events. Alternatively carry `throughSequence` from captureReplayUpperBound. Add the item to OrchestrationShellStreamItem / thread window items in packages/contracts/src/orchestration.ts and advertise a capability (e.g. `shellResumeCurrentMarker`) in the server config/welcome descriptor. (2) packages/client-runtime/src/connection/connection.ts: add `onShellResumeCurrent(environmentId)`, fired when that marker arrives after the preceding events are applied. Keep awaitingResubscribeBaseline semantics. (3) apps/web/src/environments/runtime/service.ts: drop `&& hostedGeneration === null` at 857 and pass resumeShell: true at 1296. For hosted, offer resume only when the node advertises the capability and hostedHubStore.sessionStatus !== 'delivery-unknown' and no relay requests are pending (otherwise return null -> full snapshot). Call markHostedSessionReady(environmentId, hostedGeneration) + completeQueryRefresh only from onShellResumeCurrent, guarded by acceptsEvent(). Keep the #relayGapGeneration guard in state.ts:2641-2645. (4) apps/mobile/src/hostedHub/primaryConnection.ts:243: add the same readShellResumeSequence/onShellResumeCurrent wiring, calling coordinator.markSessionReady + markHostedSessionReady like syncShellSnapshot.onCurrent at 272-286. (5) supervision.ts:561-565: allow resumable for hosted thread windows on the same connection under the same capability, and update supervision.test.ts:424-441. Phase B, cross-connection (foreground resume/retrySelectedNode). (6) Add an in-memory hosted shell baseline registry in packages/client-runtime/src/authorization (e.g. shellBaseline.ts) storing {environmentId, sequence, accountSessionId, nodeId, effectiveRole, e2ee session class}. Capture it in suspendHostedNode / the same-node branch of activateHostedNode via readShellProjectionSequence before disconnectPrimary, because supervision.ts:823 clears the tracker. Invalidate it in deactivateCurrentHostedNode (node switch demotes the store), clearAccount/sign-out, effectiveRole or directory change, and delivery-unknown. (7) connection.ts:255: accept a seeded baseline (hasShellBaseline = true, awaitingResubscribeBaseline = true for the first subscription) so a first-subscription snapshot still resets the projection and a `resumed` keeps it. Restore the projectionTracker sequence on register. (8) Move thread appliedSequence from the attach closure into ThreadDetailSubscriptionEntry so it survives remove()/attach. (9) After sign-off, update AGENTS.md:63-65 and docs/hosted-hub-client.md:381. Tests: server stream tests for the current marker after replay and absence on the snapshot path; connection.test.ts for hosted resume with no readiness until the marker, snapshot fallback resetting the projection, and the seeded baseline; update apps/web/src/hostedHub/lifecycle.integration.test.ts:234 and apps/mobile/src/hostedHub/nodeLifecycle.test.ts:86 to cover stale-generation resumed items being ignored, the relay-gap guard, and role/account change forcing a snapshot; browser suite (bun run --cwd apps/web test:browser) since this touches hosted reconnect.
